facts.text: The academic year at UC Davis is organized into three 10-week quarters (fall, winter, and spring), followed by two optional summer sessions.

sources.title: Preparing for Academic Success
sources.quote: At UC Davis, the academic year is made up of three 10-week quarters (fall, winter and spring) with two optional six-week summer sessions.

facts.text: California Community College students can earn a Transfer Admission Guarantee to UC Davis in a specific major one year before enrolling.

sources.title: Plan your transfer admission - UC Davis
sources.quote: UC Davis TAG assures your admission to UC Davis, one year before your planned enrollment. As a California Community College, or CCC, student, you use the UC TAP to apply for a UC Davis TAG in September
